config.title: Gisoo
config.region: Which Gisoo endpoint to use. Choose "iran" when gisoo.pro is not reachable directly from your network.
config.baseUrl: Custom API base URL (for example `https://gisoo.pro/api/v1`). Leave empty to follow `gisoo.region`. Your API key is sent only to this host.
config.model: Model id for new chats. Leave empty for Gisoo Auto, which picks a suitable model for each message.
config.permissionMode: What Gisoo may do without asking you first.
config.permissionMode.ask: Every edit and command waits for your approval.
config.permissionMode.autoEdit: Edits are applied directly; commands still ask.
config.permissionMode.plan: Read-only: Gisoo writes a plan and stops.
config.maxCostPerTask: Stop a run when its estimated cost (in US dollars) reaches this amount. 0 means no limit.
config.showCost: Show the estimated cost of each turn and the balance in the status bar.
config.language: Language of the Gisoo chat interface.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.subagentModel: Model id for sub-agents started with the `task` tool. Leave empty to use the chat model.
config.agents.maxParallel: How many sub-agents may run at the same time.
config.agents.maxTurns: Maximum model turns for one sub-agent before it stops.
config.compat.claude: Read Claude Code files for this folder: CLAUDE.md, `.claude/commands`, `.claude/skills`, `.claude/agents` and Claude's memory. Gisoo never writes into `~/.claude`.
config.graphify.autoInstall: Whether Gisoo may install Graphify (a local code-graph tool, PyPI package `graphifyy`) for a better understanding of the project.
config.graphify.budget: Maximum tokens a code-graph answer may use in the prompt.
config.browserPath: Path to a Chromium-based browser used for page screenshots. Leave empty to search the standard locations.
config.webFetch.enabled: Allow the `web_fetch` tool to download public web pages the agent asks for. Each fetch still asks for your approval; local and private network addresses are always refused.
config.allowedCommands: Command prefixes the agent may run without asking, for example `npm test`. Commands that chain, redirect or substitute through the shell always ask. Read from your user settings only.
config.customInstructions: Extra instructions added to every request. Read from your user settings only.
config.maxSteps: Maximum number of model steps in one task.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In an untrusted workspace Gisoo does not run commands or project-defined commands, skills and agents, and ignores workspace-level values of the endpoint, permission and tool settings.
